destinationLocationRole.description: Optional declaration of what kind of facility-layout LocationRole this path's completed work is destined for (ADR 0006). Omitted entirely means no destination role was declared — the default, and most common, case (e.g. Pick has no single destination). Immutable once set at DefinePath time; never revisable via RevisePath. This is declarative routing intent this service publishes for a downstream consumer to interpret — it is never validated against a live facility-layout lookup (this service has zero inbound/outbound dependency on any other context).
